mapper.select: SELECT c.*, d.name AS dishName, d.price AS price, d.image AS image, d.stock AS stock, d.window_id AS windowId FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = c.dish_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id
SELECT c.*, d.name AS dishName, d.price AS price, d.window_id AS windowId FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = c.dish_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.dish_id = #{dishId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, dish_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId}
